title: Consolidated failure signatures + heatmap dashboard for cross-service error analysis
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Goal: produce a single, searchable dashboard and failure-signature taxonomy that lets SREs and oncall engineers quickly identify the dominant failure modes for inference requests across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments. This ticket covers the taxonomy definition, tracing hook updates, log/metric pipeline tags, and a Grafana heatmap + signature explorer that surfaces timeouts, overloads, model-level rejections, and HTTP/gRPC status patterns.

Why: multiple teams struggle to correlate user-facing errors with root causes because traces, metrics, and log schemas are inconsistent. Current dashboards show raw error rates but not the top failure signatures leading to customer impact. A consolidated view will reduce MTTR and make rollouts safer (canary failure detection).

Scope:
- Define canonical failure signatures derived from traces/logs (timeout, request queue overload, model OOM/quantization failure, malformed prompt, downstream HTTP 5xx, gRPC UNAVAILABLE/DEADLINE_EXCEEDED, auth failures).
- Add tracing hooks (span tags and standardized attributes) to the API gateway, router, runtime, and model-hosting agents so signatures can be computed server-side and in the pipeline.
- Extend existing log/metric pipeline (Datadog/Fluentd -> metrics) to emit signature counts and top-k sampled trace IDs per signature.
- Design a Grafana dashboard: failure heatmap by service x hour, top 10 signatures, example trace sampler clickable to open trace in Jaeger, and per-model error distribution.
- Provide runbook links and suggested mitigations on the dashboard for each signature (e.g., increase queue size, change batching, fallback model).

Out of scope: long-term ML-driven anomaly detection (separate project), client-side SDK changes (follow-up).
acceptance_criteria: Canonical taxonomy document merged in Confluence with examples and example log lines
Tracing hooks PRs merged for gateway, router, runtime, and model-agent with new standardized span tags
Metric pipeline produces signature.count and signature.top_trace_ids tags for last 7 days
Grafana dashboard published to observability team folder with links to example traces and runbooks
Oncall playbook updated and validated in a tabletop with at least one SRE and one runtime engineer
